name: smwmusic-msx-valley-of-the-stars
title: msx - valley of the stars
description:
Intense song that goes to various places, fit for long grind stages.
Originally featured in Nonsense.

Note: not compatible with Bonus End, P-Switch, Yoshi, Thunder SFX, Blarggs, fireworks and death music (if using the "no death" sample group). You can use it with death music at the cost of no starman and stage clear themes (use the "no goal" sample group).
